abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has Ward (6+) while it is wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

abilities.name: Consecrate the Land
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an objective you control that this unit is contesting to be the target.
abilities.effect: If there are no enemy units contesting the target objective, it is considered by you to be consecrated. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, the target objective is considered by you to be consecrated. While they are wholly within 6" of a consecrated objective and under orders: • Friendly non-War Machine Sigmarite units have Ward (5+). • Friendly Sigmarite War Machines have Ward (6+). If your opponent gains control of a consecrated objective, it is no longer consecrated.

units.name: Pontifex Zenestra, Matriarch of the Great Wheel

abilities.name: The Great Wheel Turns
abilities.effect: Each time a model in a visible friendly Sigmarite unit wholly within 12" of this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, make a number of zealotry rolls of D6 equal to that model's Health characteristic. For each 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking units after the Fight ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: Vessel of Sigmar
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Make a chanting roll of D6. If the roll is an unmodified 1, you can re-roll the dice.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects. Pick up to 2 different effects instead if the chanting roll was 10+. *Sanctified Ground:* Until the start of your next turn, visible enemy units that use a Charge ability while they are within 9" of this unit have Strike-last for the rest of the turn. *Ardent Prayers:* Add 1 to zealotry rolls for friendly Sigmarite units until the start of your next turn. *Cast Out Evil:* Roll a D3 for each visible enemy Wizard and Priest on the battlefield. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

units.name: Pontifex Zenestra, Matriarch of the Great Wheel (Scourge of Aqshy)

abilities.name: Sigmar's Blessing
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Sigmarite unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn: • The target's melee weapons have Charge (+1 Damage). • If the chanting roll was 10+, the target has Ward (5+) if it charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Unquenchable Faith
abilities.effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, this unit can immediately use the 'Sigmar's Blessing' ability as if it were your hero phase. If it does so: • That prayer does not count towards the number of Prayer abilities this unit can use this phase. • Instead of making a chanting roll for that prayer, you must use a value of 10 for the roll that cannot be modified. • The effect of that prayer applies for the rest of the battle instead of until the start of your next turn.

units.name: Pontifex Zenestra, Matriarch of the Great Wheel (Scourge of Ghyran)

weapons.name: Sceptre of the Wheel and Acolytes' Weapons

abilities.name: Word of the God-King
abilities.timing: Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy Wizard, Priest or Manifestation within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+: • If the target is a Manifestation, it is banished and removed from the battlefield.. • If the target is a Wizard or Priest, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: Sigmar's Will
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Make a chanting roll of D6. If the roll is an unmodified 1, you can re-roll the dice.
abilities.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects. Pick up to 2 different effects instead if the chanting roll was 10+. *Hallowed Ground:* Until the start of your next turn, enemy units using the 'Normal Move' ability cannot end that move within 5" of a friendly Cities of Sigmar Human unit while it is wholly within 12" of this unit. *Fervent Prayers:* Until the start of your next turn, each time a friendly Cities of Sigmar Human model is slain by a combat attack while it is wholly within 12" of this unit and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the Fight ability has been resolved. *Salvation:* Pick 1 friendly Cities of Sigmar Human unit that is more than 12" from this unit and not in combat to be the target. Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units. That unit cannot use Charge abilities for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Runes of Spellbreaking
abilities.effect: This unit can use the 'Unbind' ability as if it had Wizard (1).

abilities.name: Forgefire
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Cities of Sigmar Duardin unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of each target's melee weapons.

abilities.name: Prize Specimens
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit's shooting attacks that target enemy Monsters.

abilities.name: Cruel Sacrifice
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly Cities of Sigmar Aelf unit wholly within 6" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn. Then, roll a dice. On a 4+, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

abilities.name: Word of Pain
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target's attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Black Dragon's Claws is 4.

abilities.name: Command Underlings
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly Cities of Sigmar Aelf Infantry units wholly within 12" of this unit to be targets.
abilities.effect: Add 3" to the Move characteristic of each target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Feed on Life Force
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If any enemy models are slain by this ability, place a dark sorcery token next to this unit for the rest of the battle, to a maximum of 3 tokens.

abilities.name: Dark Sorcery
abilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for each dark sorcery token it has.

abilities.name: More Pressure!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll is less than the number of damage points this unit has, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit. Otherwise, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to this unit until the start of your next turn: *Power the Wheels:* This unit can use a Run ability and still use Shoot and/or Charge abilities later in the turn. *Power the Guns:* Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Steam Gun.

abilities.name: Division Commander
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly Steam Tank units to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by this unit and by each target.

abilities.name: More Pressure!
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll is less than the number of damage points this unit has, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit. Otherwise, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to this unit until the start of your next turn: *Power the Wheels:* This unit can use a Run ability and still use Shoot and/or Charge abilities later in the turn. *Power the Guns:* Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Steam Gun.

units.name: Tahlia Vedra, Lioness of the Parch

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of Infernadine's Leonine Jaws is 2.

abilities.name: Combat Tactician
abilities.timing: Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a visible friendly Sigmarite Infantry unit wholly within 18" of it and that is not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: The target can immediately use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase. In addition, the target is under orders for the rest of the battle round.

abilities.name: Lead from the Front
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is in combat, pick each visible friendly Sigmarite unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for the targets' combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Paralysing Venom
abilities.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the target's Health characteristic, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Impossible To Destroy
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.effect: Heal (6) this unit.

abilities.name: Six-headed Strike
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll 6 dice. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: Fearless Leader
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly Cities of Sigmar Duardin unit that has not used a Fight ability this turn and is within this unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved.

abilities.name: Ancestral Grudgebearer
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in your opponent's army to bear a grudge against. You can pick an enemy unit that is in reserve.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Cities of Sigmar Duardin units that target that unit.

abilities.name: Expert Pathfinders
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Deployment Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and up to two friendly non-Monster non-War Machine Sigmarite units if none of them have been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up those units in reserve scouting ahead. They have now been deployed.

abilities.name: Prepared Arrival
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit if it is scouting ahead.
abilities.effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up each other friendly unit scouting ahead wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Form Up
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly Cities of Sigmar unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly Cities of Sigmar units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets. The unit using this ability and the targets: • cannot be under orders. • must each be a different unit type.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are under orders. Designer's Note: *'Unit type' refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. 'Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal' or 'Cannonade Cogfort'.*

battleTraits.name: Take Aim
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is under orders to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Pick 1 of that unit's ranged weapons. Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made with that weapon for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Sound the Attack
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a Charge ability for a unit that is under orders
battleTraits.effect: You can change the lowest D6 in the charge roll to match the highest D6.

battleTraits.name: Into Them, You Dogs!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly Hero that is under orders to use this ability. That unit is the field officer for the rest of the turn. Then, pick 2 other visible friendly non-Hero units that are under orders and wholly within 12" of the field officer to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time the field officer uses a Fight ability, you can pick a target that has not used a Fight ability this turn. That target is inspirited and the other target is emboldened.The inspirited target can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the Fight ability used by the field officer has been resolved. Then, if the emboldened target has not used a Fight ability this turn, it can be picked to use a Fight ability immediately after the inspirited target's Fight ability has been resolved.

battleTraits.name: Hurl Them Back!
battleTraits.timing: One Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is under orders and in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit's melee weapons.

abilities.name: Masters of the Arcane
abilities.effect: Add 1 to arcane manipulation rolls and banishment rolls for friendly Wizards that are under orders. Designer's Note: *Wizards in this battletome use arcane manipulation rolls for a variety of powerful effects.*

abilities.name: I've Seen Worse and Killed Better
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with any friendly Cities of Sigmar Duardin units that did not charge this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target's combat attacks have no effect for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: To the Last
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly unit that is under orders uses the 'Rally' command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilities.name: Dawnbringer Crusade
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-Hero Cities of Sigmar Infantry unit wholly within friendly territory to use this ability.
abilities.effect: If that unit is in combat, it can move 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of the move. It does not have to end the move in combat. If that unit is not in combat, it can move 6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: Have No Mercy
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of the next battle round, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Cities of Sigmar Aelf units that target that enemy unit while it is damaged or has had any models slain in the same turn.

abilities.name: Throngs of the Faithful
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Your opponent declared a Fight ability.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Sigmarite units that target the enemy unit using that Fight ability.

abilities.name: Beloved Leader
abilities.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls applied by enemy abilities for attacks made by visible friendly units that are wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders.

abilities.name: Grizzled Drillmaster
abilities.effect: Other visible friendly units have Ward (6+) while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders.

abilities.name: Stentorian General
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are in combat with any visible friendly units that are wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders.

abilities.name: Bones of Saint Ignifus
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a Spell or Prayer ability for a visible unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and under orders
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the casting roll or chanting roll for that ability.

abilities.name: The Last Blade of Embergard
abilities.timing: Deployment Phase
abilities.effect: This unit can use this ability while it is in reserve. Pick 1 of this unit's non-Companion melee weapons. Add 2 to that weapon's Attacks characteristic and Rend characteristic for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: The Sphere Celestial
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a point on the battlefield within 1" of this unit and more than 3" from all other units (friendly and enemy) and terrain features to be the target point. Then, pick another visible friendly Cities of Sigmar Infantry or Cavalry Hero that is wholly within 18" of this unit and not in combat to be the target unit.
abilities.effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target unit and not in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target point and not in combat. This unit and the target unit can use Move abilities in the following movement phase (this is an exception to Core Rules, 24.0).

abilities.name: Curse of Scorched Metal
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Cities of Sigmar Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the first time the target uses an Attack ability, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made by the target as part of that Attack ability, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after that Attack ability has been resolved.

abilities.name: High Star's Light
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Cities of Sigmar Wizard to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Cities of Sigmar unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Speed of the Twin-tailed Comet
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Cities of Sigmar Wizard to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the Move characteristic of friendly non-War Machine Cities of Sigmar units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

abilities.name: Holy Aegis
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Cities of Sigmar Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Cities of Sigmar unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each target in each phase.

abilities.name: Benediction of the High Heavens
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Cities of Sigmar Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Cities of Sigmar unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: Heal (D3) the target and the chanter. If the chanting roll was 7+, Heal (D3) each visible friendly Cities of Sigmar unit wholly within 12" of the chanter instead.

abilities.name: Reckoning of Sinners
abilities.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Cities of Sigmar Priest to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly Cities of Sigmar unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
abilities.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with any of the targets.
